name: Berliner Kaffeerösterei
review: Very good. Lots of space to a stroller and clean.

name: Café auf dem Kranoldplatz
review: It is a cafe inside a cointainer and they have a WC with a changing table! Amazing!!

name: DUMP LING’S
review: Table is pretty ok, standard. They have high chairs, but the restaurant can be very crowded. Besides that, they don‘t mind about you entering with a kinderwagen and gave us a good table for our family of 3.

name: Factory Girl
review: The bathroom at Factory girl is clean, and the changing table is also in good condition. 10/10, would definitely change here again!

name: La Femme
review: They have eating chairs and a clean decent changing table(but downstairs so can't go with the stroller). Recently went there and they also made no trouble of me ordering plain yogurt and scrabbled egg for my toddler. He really had the best time.

name: Spreegold
review:
This Spreegold was very accommodating to us! They even have a play corner in their back room with two big boxes of kids toys and books. My 13mo had a blast going through the toys and I could drink my decaf cappuccino in peace. We felt very welcome here. 

(Photo of toys is from the play corner, not the bathroom).

name: Sowohl Als Auch
review:
The changing table is nothing more than a large shelf in the window sill, but it works! If you carry one of those diaper pouches that folds out into a pad or a changing mat, you'll be good to go. 

This cafe is a bit tight and basically made of stairs (there are a few steps to get in, and the bathroom with the changing table is down a winding staircase), so it's not great if you need to navigate with a stroller. But if you're babywearing, it's no problem.

name: Dots
review: It has a clean changing table. Staff was very kind to mom and baby.

name: KALLE HALLE Markthalle
review: New clean food hall. Only paper towels are missing inside the handicapped toilet but they are outside in the main toilet sink room.

name: Brauhaus Georgbraeu
review: Located in the women's bathroom. Changing table was perfect and clean, however,b you need to go down the stairs to access the bathroom

name: Pablo Neruda Bezirksbibliothek
review: A changing room with a simple table without soft surface. It's a proper closable room with a sink in the 1st floor. Open access.

name: Heinrich-Böll-Stiftung
review: Easily and publicly accessible on the ground floor during working hours (8-20.00), clean and friendly

name: Lantana Cafe Berlin
review:
Very nice, clean and friendly place. Including a little toys corner.
Only disadvantage are a few steps at the entrance, but stroller can also be parked at the top.

name: Brasserie Bellanger
address: 140 Rue du Faubourg Poissonnière, 75010 Paris, France
review: What a joke! The room with the changing table was packed with suitcases, and I had to change my baby on a counter in the open area of the bathroom where you wash your hands.

name: Starbucks
review: It's so rare to find a changing table in Paris that you're so happy when you do find one that you don't even notice the dirt or the line you have to wait in. You need a code to open the bathroom door.

name: Leonie
review: The Paris classic: there's no changing table, but there's an extended sink counter that you can use for changing.

name: L'Atelier Entrecôte & Volaille
review: It's not exactly a changing table, but there's enough space on the sink for an emergency diaper change.

name: Du‘ana Café
review: Very nice one!

name: Le Bon Marche Rive
review: It's ok.

name: Aéroport de Paris-Charles de Gaulle
review: Very good! And they have many of them in every terminal, floor etc. Some of them even have a small toilet for kids!

name: Blumental
review: Changing table in good condition in the wheelchair bathroom with wet whipes available. It’s possible to navigate there with the stroller but could be a bit tight.

name: Britzer Garten
review: For a changing table inside bathrooms located in containers, it's excellent. Very clean.

name: BLOCK HOUSE
review: Excellent. The only problem is that you have to carry the baby in your arms, since you have to take the stairs to get there.

name: Saravanaa Bhavan
review: Extremely cramped space.

name: James June
review: You need to walk all the way to the end of the hallway where the restrooms are, open a door that leads to the staff area, and there you'll find the accessible restroom on the left. The changing table is there.

name: See- und Sporthotel Ankum
review: It is located in the female toilet next to the restaurant entrance (where breakfast is). Very practical and clean.

name: Tsomi
review: Ask the staff to show you where the changing table is, it’s in a technical room

name: dm
review: Plenty of space with supplies.

name: Napolita
review: Clean!

name: BRLO Brwhouse
review: Clean changing table next to the sink. Soap and towels available. In the ladies toilet.

name: Das Schloss
review: It was a separate bathroom. I was surprised of how spacious and how colourful it was. What I appreciated was that there was an adult size toilete that I guess could also be used for toddlers. There was also a comfortable chair inside.

name: Casa Nila
review: The staff is friendly and the boss has a little child too

name: H&M
address: H&M inside the Tempelhofer Hafen Shopping Center
review: Inside the big changing room in the downstairs changing area. A comfortable chair for nursing is also available in the same stall.

name: KaDeWe
review: located on the 4th floor in the kids section there is a nursing room with a changing table, really nice and quiet

name: Hotel und Restaurant Zum Deutschen Hause Lübbenau
review: Regular changing table inside the women’s restroom

name: Denkmal für die ermordeten Juden Europas
review: There is a changing table inside the wheelchair restroom. You can go downstairs with an elevator. It’s a bit of a hassle to access the building as everyone needs to do a quick security check. So they quickly check the bags you carry with you. Staff was super friendly and helpful when I asked if I can just come downstairs quickly to change my daughters diaper.

name: Besucherzentrum der Gedenkstätte Berliner Mauer
review: Would be 10, but you need to request a key to the toilet at the front desk

name: Luisenbräu
review: Great changing table, but bathroom are downstairs what makes it difficult if you need to carry baby and bags.

name: Espresso House
review: Quite good changing table but you need an access code to the toilet

name: Brauhaus Spandau
review: Clean

name: Berliner Bergbrauerei
review: It's a decent Changing table inside the womens toilet. The Beergarden has a really cool slide for small kids though

name: L´Osteria Berlin AM TACHELES
review: There’s free diapers for infants but not for older babies

name: Oshione
review: A clean, fresh, and baby-friendly bakery café toilet with everything you may need, including soap, towels, and a clean changing table. The thoughtful facilities and baby-friendly service make visiting with little ones easy and comfortable.

name: Manfred-Bofinger-Bibliothek im Gerard Philipe
review: They have one at the female bathroom and another one at the male. Very nice and clean. It was a nice surprise!

name: Freilandmuseum Lehde
review: Confortable and practical. It was good to find a nice place to change my baby.

name: Kleine Schwimmhalle Wuhlheide
review: It is so nice! They have lots of changing tables, close to the poll area, in the changing room (with privacy). I loved it!

name: ANOHA – Die Kinderwelt des Jüdischen Museums Berlin
review: It's in very good condition and is located in a separate bathroom, which ensures privacy when changing diapers.

name: Marheineke Markthalle
review: You have to pay 0,70 to use the toilet, but maybe if you ask them, they allow you to change your baby for free. Conditions are ok… I have seen better ones!

name: Schwimm- und Sprunghalle im Europasportpark (SSE)
review: There are many changing tables at this Schwimmbad both in the lady changing rooms and at the baby pool. They do their job, nothing fancy. Only accessible after you have paid the entrance fee though.

name: COMEBUY
review: It is ok. Not great, but at least there is one!

name: UNSER CAFÉ
review: Standard. Not good, not bad – but it could be better, for sure :)

name: Boteco do Bigode
address: R. T-65-A - St. Bela Vista, Goiânia - GO, 74823-380, Brasil
review: It’s inside a restroom for kids. The changing table is spacious and clean, and there are wet wipes available.

name: AMRIT Indian Restaurant Potsdamer Platz
review: Super child friendly staff! Unfortunately, the changing table is a foldable one downstairs in the corridor near the bathroom, not much privacy and very tight space when the table is in use.

name: Mercado Municipal da Cidade de Goiás
review: It’s not a proper changing table, but a space next to the sink that serves for the purpose. It’s present both in the women’s and men’s restroom.

name: Vito Café
review: Even though the bathroom is very narrow, they made sure to include a changing table. Love it!

name: Órion Business & Health Complex
address: Av. Portugal, 1148 - St. Marista, Goiânia - GO, 74150-030
review: Clean, private, accessible regardless the gender of the caregiver

name: Zeiss-Großplanetarium
review: The table is large and there is plenty if space in the room (fits a Kinderwagen).

name: Winterfeld Schokoladen
review: Changing table is in the hallway in front of the men’s and women’s toilet. There’s also toys there and a high chair.

name: Humanistische Schwangerschaftskonfliktberatung
review: Very nice and well organized. Also pretty clean. Tip top!

name: Stavros Niarchos
address: Center, Leof. Andrea Siggrou 364, Kallithea 176 74, Greece
review: Standard. Pretty fine.

name: Fraport Besucherzentrum
address: Terminal 1, Flughafen Frankfurt, 60549 Frankfurt am Main
review: Very good and clean.

name: Stilbruch Kaffee
review: Nice, clean, and had wet wipes available.

name: Eierhäuschen Biergarten
review: The location isn't ideal, but it was clean. Bonus points because there's also a changing table in the men's restroom.

name: Prater Biergarten
review: It is not an actual changing table but a sorr of a table in the female toilet where you could change a diaper. No mat, no privacy. They could do better.

name: Louis Café-Restaurant
review: Not reall a changing table but a space between windows that can be used to change a diaper. They have enough space and should arrange a real one.

name: CarlaConradPaula
review: Pretty clean and comfy table, had wet towels and some diapers available.

name: Luna Sentada
address: Fondamenta S. Severo, 5018, 30122 Venezia VE, Italy
review: It is a nice one made of wood, and they had the cushion that was pretty clean.

name: McDonald's
review: I think it is great that Mc Donald‘s offers diapers and wet wipers under request :)) very good!

name: Familienzentrum Schivelbeiner Straße
review: Great changing table located on kids restroom. The only problem is that this belongs to the kita in the same building, but can be used by kids from the Familienzentrum Krabbelgruppe.

name: Familienzentrum Parkstraße
review: Great changing table with some diapers available, but only a few sizes.

name: Hard Rock Cafe Venice
address: Bacino Orseolo , San Marco 1192, 30124 Venezia VE, Italy
review: Pretty basic, it's above a sink, my baby got distracted with the faucet :)

name: Pura Vida Beach
review: Was full of sand but hey, we were on the beach

name: Birraria La Corte
review: Pretty clean, the only downside is that you need to ask for a key for the room (probably that's why it was super clean)

name: Oyoun
review: Restrooms are in the -1 and access is via stairs. Not sure if there is an elevator (maybe?). Not ideal, but okay.

name: Mercado SantaAna (Mercado de Abastos)
review: Great changing table, but no sign that there’s a changing table. I found it out of curiosity when i decided to check the wheelchair bathroom.

name: MOM Brunch & Coffee
address: C. San Antonio, 48, 29680 Estepona, Málaga, Espanha
review: Changing table in really good condition, besides, the wallpaper catches baby attention and distracts them, making it easier to change the diaper.

name: Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport
address: Av. del Comandante García Morato, s/n, Churriana, 29004, Málaga, Espanha
review:
Changing table in family restroom is great, but many non-family travelers were using this restroom, making the baby quite exposed during diaper changing. Family restrooms can be found next to VIP area at the boarding gates.
Toddler toilet is also available.
Airport also has a lactation room available, although it was closed when I try to use it.

name: Wilde-Heimat
review:
Could be in a closed room, but since the place has a family vibe, the location didn’t disturbed too much.
Dedicated toilets for toddlers are also available.

name: NHU Nachbarschaftshaus Urbanstraße
review: Very good! There are plenty diapers to use free of charge and toys for distract the baby during the change. 10 of 10!

name: Café TreBo
review: Very cool!!

name: Shanghai Disneyland Park
review: It's a good changing table, but it could offer more privacy.

name: Tian'an Sunshine Plaza
review: Clean, decent, with pretty space for a diaper change.

name: National Assembly Statiom
review: They even have a chair where you can safely secure your baby so you can go to the bathroom in peace.

name: Yeouido Station
review: They even have a chair where you can safely secure your baby so you can go to the bathroom in peace.

name: Super Brand Mall
address: 168 Lujiazui W Rd, Lujiazui, Pudong, Shanghai, China, 200092
review: Like any good shopping mall, they have a dedicated room. Also with a breastfeeding corner, with a chair.

name: Kő Büfé
address: Budapest Schulek Frigyes sétány Margitsziget, 1138 Hungary
review: Have to pay 200 ft (+-0,60€). It was very clean for a toilet in a park.

name: Padthai Wokbar
review: It was good, it was like in a secondary room inside the women's bathroom. Had a hanger and it was pretty clean.

name: New York Cafe
review: The place is mega fancy, i expected more... the changing table is literally by the sinks where people wash hands, the fancy ladies were not happy with the poop smell (: it had a cushion though.

name: mama trattoria Hamburg Wellingsbüttel
review: This Restaurant is always Nice with Kids, very relaxed stuff and they have colouring stuff and even some Books for the Little ones. At the changing table they have some diapers, but not in all sizes.

name: Budni
review: Diapers, wet wipes, disinfectant spray, and other items are available for free.

name: Krohnstieg Center
review: Changing Table missing (currently Broken) :(

name: Blume an der Hasenheide
review: Not good, not bad. It is a foldable table on the top of the toilet. It is ok and a good option if you are in the park.

name: Tejeringos
address: C/ Méndez Núñez, 6, Distrito Centro, 29008 Málaga, Spain
review: Was a simple plastic table on the wall, no cushion, but it was fine.

name: NEST CoWork & Play
review: There are children’s restrooms, nap and nursing rooms, and, of course, a changing station.

name: Savoiardi
address: C/ de Ribera, Nº 16, Ciutat Vella, 46002
review: There is a free toilet downstairs with a changing table.

name: Stadteilzentrum Prenzlauerberg
review: Really clean and well stocked!

name: Restaurant Paran
review: It's not a real changing table but a restaurant table which serves as one.

name: Noriboi
review: It’s not exactly a changing table, but if you remove the flower arrangement, you can use the counter as a place to change diapers.

name: Kinderspielzimmer Familiencafé Bunter Elefant
review: Really clean and next to toddler toilet

name: El Horno
address: C. Cam. Viejo de Vélez, 16, 29700 Vélez-Málaga, Málaga, Spain
review: It is simply a changing table by the sinks. There was a too small garbage bin, no paper towels, no toilet paper (it was outside the bathrooms). But hey, it is something.

name: Zeiss-Großplanetarium
review: Changing table in good condition, but only one available. On days with kids special projections the line can be quite long and take a while.

name: Petit Brunch
review: Really good condition, a lot of space.

name: Braumanufaktur Templin
review:
Nice place in general, small playground for kids with a big bouncing bubble and some goats and chickens.
Changing table is okay, the light in the room could be brighter.

name: ROSSMANN
review: There is also a little play and a relax area. It's amazing!

name: Gardens by the Bay
review: Really clean and nice

name: PLAYMOBIL -Fun Park PLAYMOBIL-FunPark
review: There is a dedicated diaper-changing room in the park, as well as a small wc for the little ones.

name: dm
review: Very nice and clean, dm standard. But the day I was there, they were restocking the shelves and had parked the cart used to transport the products right next to them. It was a bit of a bother.

name: Stadtteilzentrum Pankow
review: Clean and enough room for a stroller. No supplies available but the building has more than one changing table available.

name: Zoo Wroclaw
review: Really clean and well located. There are mpre changing tables around the zoo and they all have straps to tie the baby.

name: Wrocław Główny
review: Super clean, with hand paper near to reach without leaving the baby alone, also easy to tie the baby. The room is big enough for a stroller and there is a chair to breastfeed. The room remais locked, but the personal is super attentive and nice. They opened and cleaned the room for us before we even asked for it.

name: Kinderbauernhof Pinke-Panke
review: More than enough space, but the toilet line in the way. Room is a bit dark, but fits the farm vibe.

name: MALI Berlin
review: Clean and has a heater, but it is located on a hallway downstairs, impossible to reach with a stroller and a bit exposed.

name: Agriturismo Le Valli
address: Via dei Murazzi, 1d, 30126 Venezia VE, Italy

name: Pontal Shopping
review: Very good!

name: Ristorante Chinese FU
address: Salita del teatro, 3997/C, 30124 Venezia VE, Italy
review: It is really just the changing table, there is no mattress. But it is new and the bathroom was very clean. In the women's restroom :/

name: Restaurante Casa Rafaello
review: It's pretty odd: it looks like a bench with a mattress on top (or just a padded bench to sit on, only taller). There isn't enough privacy for changing the baby.

name: Oro’s Restaurante
review: It’s improvised, but it works.

name: Flughafen Frankfurt
review: Very clean and spacious. They provide disposable paper to protect the mat, which I think is great.

name: Flughafen Zürich
review: It's in the women's restroom. I couldn't find another one in a separate room, but I know there's a family center somewhere in the international departure area.

name: Templo Budista Chagdud Gonpa Khadro Ling
review: It’s not the best place for a changing table – it’s tucked away in a corner near the trash can and the mop – but if you’re in a pinch, it can come in handy.

name: Aeroporto Internacional de São Paulo/Guarulhos
review: The space is very nice and clean, but what surprised me most was the sink, which lets you clean up your baby in case of “accidents” or give them a quick refresh before a long flight. The changing table shown in the photo is located inside the international departure terminal.

name: Le Grand Burger
review: There are two. One inside the cabin and one next to the sink. It's a bit cramped.

name: Fundação Iberê Camargo
review: The standard that works.

name: Doces Maquiné
review: It does the job. It’s very clean, and my baby enjoyed playing with the wall decorations while I was changing him.

name: Al Theatro
review: Good space, looks comfy, it's in the wheelchair bathroom so men and women can enter.

name: Spore Initiative
review: Very good one!

name: Gropius Bau
review: Not sure if I like changing my baby in the middle of the female restroom. It would be better a discret corner or its own room. Plus point because they have small toilets for kids.

name: Parthenon
review:
It's not for short people, but worked for me. 
When you use it the bathroom is blocked.

name: Serways Raststätte Fränkische Schweiz-Pegnitz West
review: They have a heat lamp, paper to cover the changing mat and a special (closed) trash for diapers. Also a chair to lock your toddler if you want to use the toilet. Excelent!

name: MEDICOLEO
review: Nice that they have one

name: Café Cutie Pie
review: It is very good that they have not just a changing table but also a play area for the kids. As a mother, you feel very welcomed to drink your coffee :)

name: Kaffeehaus Madlen
review: Really clean and looks like new, it’s also super cute. There are wickel unterlagen available.

name: Publix
review: Lots of space, very clean, with elevator to access the lower level with a stroller. Pretty good and recommended — also because you can sneak in and use the changing table without having to buy anything at the café.

name: Ikea
review: Accessibility is good, suitable for both parents. There's a chair for breastfeeding. It's constantly cleaned. The downside is its proximity to the dining area and the high volume of people passing by; despite having a door, there's a lot of noise.

name: Vivantes Klinikum Am Urban
review: The table itself is fine but the hospital emergency is not a nice place…

name: Umami
review: There is plenty space in the toilet and it looks clean. The restaurant is super kids-friendly. They are SUPER nice to kids (and parents with baby/kids).

name: Gasthaus Figl
review: It is a foldable changing table „forgot“ in the corner, but pretty ok to use.

name: Boulevard Berlin
review: Wärmelampe

name: Bourbon Shopping
review: They have a space for families, a family toilet, with changing table and a toilet for the minis. Amazing!

name: Havan
review: Very nice and clean.

name: Viva Open Mall
review: Very nice family bathroom where you can chance a diaper or breastfeed. You can also use the toilet.

name: The Boat Kaffee
review: Cramped space, but at least they have one.

name: La Fève
review: The table is okay, but the cafe is mega kids friendly! They have a kids corner and you should leave your stroller outside the place — but they lock it up themselves outside :))

name: Le Brot
review: It is in a very small room and a bit improvised — but at least they have one! Extra points because they have a kids corner for the small ones :)

name: Ludothek global (Global Village)
review: It‘s clean and you have plenty space.

name: Cafe Babette
review: Very good one! Only problem is that you can just access the cafeteria floor by stairs (just one part of the cafe has access via lift). Cappuccino is 2,80€!!!

name: Aeroporto Internacional de Porto Alegre - Salgado Filho
review: It is located on the toilet door. No privacy at all — but maybe there are better ones located in another floor at the airport (this one is next to the food court, second floor).

name: Cais Embarcadero
review: It is inside a container (like all the toilets there), but pretty good and clean.

name: Boulevard Laçador
review: Very good one!

name: Autohof Thiersheim
review:
Absolut gem on the A93.
They have a Restaurant with a big play area for kids all ages and this not super nice looking, but very well equipped changing table! Much recommended!

name: El Mero Mexicano
review: It's a little strange and hard to open.

name: dm
review: There is also a "Stilecke" available :)

name: Ristorante Pavarotti
review: You have to go downstairs to access the toilet.

name: monkey bar | neni Berlin
review: it's a bit dark, but a good changing table in general!

name: Schnitzelei Charlottenburg
review: Nice restaurant to go with kids, they give them something to paint and have a decent changing table. Just be careful going down the tricky stairs holding a baby!

name: Sphere Bar im Fernsehturm
review: It was a toilet and was adjusted to a diaper station. It’s tight and not so comfy but at least you have a place to change hehe

name: Sana Klinikum Lichtenberg Sozialpädiatrisches Zentrum
review: Very good and clean. It was not a busy day when we went there, so not sure how it would be if the emergency room would be full…

name: McDonald's
review: Very good option for a change while travelling! Our stroller is small and did not fit in the room. There is even a warm lamp (see photo).

name: Europa Center
review: Located in 1EG , in the restroom area close to Saturn. It costs 0.5 but has lots of space and it is pretty clean, the changing mat was nice and comfortable also.

name: Hotel Zoe
review: The changing table is metal and I wasnt very sure if it would hold my baby. All well, but didnt have trust at first

name: The Playce
review: It is located in OG level of the mall near the restaurant zone. You pay for your use 0.7 euro (you can change the diaper, then return to the women's restroom with no extra cost). it is a nice dedicated room, it has a chair that could be used for breastfeeding as well, clean and spacious.

name: Wolf Kino
review: Very good! It is also a must since they offer a session for babies on tuesday morning :)

name: Obi Lichtenberg
review: The changing table was fine, but the room didnt smell too good

name: porta Möbel
review: Lots of space for a stroller inside the room. Changing table is simple, but very good.

name: Shopping Via Catarina
review: One of the best places I have ever seen to change diapers. They have many changing tables (female toilet, dedicaded room etc) and they also have mini toilets for toddlers in both female and male toilets. Amazing!

name: Aeroporto Sá Carneiro
address: Pedras Rubras, 4470-558 Vila Nova da Telha, Portugal

name: InterContinental Porto - Palácio das Cardosas
review: It is in the hotel and if you ask nicely they probably will let you use it.

name: Trinity Porto
address: R. dos Heróis e dos Mártires de Angola 49, 4000-285 Porto, Portugal
review: There is a mini toilet for troddlers and a chair for breastfeeding.

name: Ikea Lichtenberg
review:
Ikea is ideal for a visit with a Baby.
They have everything you need and even a room for private nursing.

name: A Padaria Portuguesa
review: Not so much space. In front of the sink. If you use it, other people can‘t access the toilet. No easy access (stair).

name: Pingo Doce Boavista
review: Terrible. Floor mega dirty. No toilet paper. I suggest to avoid it, but if you have no other option, then give it a try — maybe you have more luck than me.

name: KALLE HALLE Markthalle
review: Room for stroller and table is clean. The lighting could be a little better.

name: ALEX
review: Very low.

name: Bikini Cabanyal
address: C/ de les Drassanes, 52, Poblats Marítims, 46011 València, Valencia

name: RIGATONI Familien- und Nachbarschaftstreff
review: Very nice, no defects at all! Already changed my baby many times there :)

name: EDEKA Treugut
review: You must ask for the key in the bakery.

name: L'Oceanogrŕfic
address: C/ d'Eduardo Primo Yúfera, 1, Quatre Carreres, 46013

name: Forum Schwanthalerhöhe
review: There is a big Family Toilet with changing table, also in the regular womens toilets there is a big stall where you can go inside with a stroller, which is very convenient!

name: Dussmann
review:
The changing table is right next to the sinks, where very loud hand dryers go off every couple of seconds (when it's busy) and that scared the hell out of my baby and she cried terribly! would never change diapers there again while busy. 

No photo because of the streeeeeess

name: Ostsee Park
review: There are three changing tables located in small separate areas in the women's and men's restrooms (yes!). There is also a changing table in the accessible restroom. Amazing!

name: dm
review: Mega complete. They have all supplies that are needed to change a diaper :)

name: Kiez & Kugel
review: The changing table is merely a normal table in the bathroom but it is sufficient

name: La Maison des Histoires
review: Small toilets for kids.

name: Familienzentrum Juli
review: Super nice, lots of space, always clean.

name: Gorilla
review: Very nice; there's space for a stroller inside the bathroom (but you can also leave it parked outside). Everything was very clean.

name: Tapiocaria
review: Decent and clean, but very cramped and installed too high. Bad for short parents

name: Fiore
review: not often used

name: Kaffee Barista
review: It's downstairs, so no stroller, but clean and enough space

name: KERB Berlin
review: The room/toilet could be better lit.

name: Kurhaus Zingst
review:
You have to ask at the front desk to open the door to the wheelchair toilet.
Best and cleanest changing table for me so far!

name: Tomasa
review: Very confortable and clean, but need to take stairs to access it.

name: Gasthaus Seibl Fam. Bayer
review: The changing table is good but the restaurant service is TERRIBLE. I don‘t recommend it.

name: Serways Raststätte Aichen Nord
review: Mega dirty!

name: Zum Fliegenden Holländer
review: The changing table is a desk in the hallway that leads to the bathrooms. Both the bathrooms and the table are upstairs

name: Arlberg WellCom
review: There is a family changing room with changing table available.

name: Rastanlage Frankenwald West
review: Very good! You can use it for free. There is 2 changing tables in a dedicated room and another one in the wheelchair toilett. Plenty space for a stroller.

name: Genezarethkirche
review: It’s one of the best Krabbelgruppe in Berlin, and the diaper changing station is really nice. There are usually diapers available on site, since people donate them (though they’re usually small sizes).

name: Haus der Wannsee Konferenz
review: Never expected a changing table there in the museum but it was in a good but a little bit dirty condition

name: PalaisPopulaire
review: Very clean, you don’t have to go in the museum

name: Il Ritrovo
review: It seems dirty and messy, but actually it is very clean and there is lots of space for a baby, a stroller, to leave your stuff while changing etc. Very good.

name: K-Fetisch
review: It is a clapping table.

name: RumBa
review: It’s a family café, it looks dusty and dirty from the outside but is really clean and the people are so nice and friendly

name: Das Café in der Gartenakademie
review: A small table but conditions are okay, it’s left side of the women’s toilet

name: Zauberküche
review: Really beautiful place for brunch, but the changing room is full with other stuff too so space is limited

name: Benedict Prenzlauerberg
review: Clean

name: Serways Raststätte Schafstrift Nord
review: Amazing and clean. You have a dedicated room with a sink and a small seat. Enough space to move and pull stuff out of the bag. Paper to use as mat. Top!

name: Berliner Toilette Weichselstraße
review: It was out of order when I passed by on July 18, 2025.

name: Zooparque
address: Avenida ZooParque Itatiba, Rodovia Dom Pedro I, KM 95.5, 13254-762

name: Humboldt Forum
review: Amazing! They have many changing tables in all museum areas available. Excelent.

name: Camponesa
address: Rod. Pres. Castello Branco, s/n, km 198, Zona Rural, 18640-000

name: LA MAISON
review: Very dirty. Not enough light (very dark toilet to perform a diaper change).

name: Tierra Garat Porfirio
address: Av Porfirio Díaz 66, Noche Buena, Benito Juárez, 03720

name: 60 seconds to napoli
review: Unfortunately dirty (needs to be washed)

name: East Side Mall
review: There is a dm downstairs, but if you  are upstairs, want some privacy and maybe sit down to feed, thats a great option and it's squeeky clean, large and in good condition :)

name: Fridas Eiskrem
review: You need to go down to the toilets so no chance to get there with stroller, but it’s outside the women’s and men’s restrooms so everybody can change diapers ;)

name: Plansche im Plänterwald (Wasserspielplatz)
review: Very nice and clean for a Plansche.

name: ZOLA
review: There isn't a diaper changing station as such, but there are several sofas and tables on the first floor and in the basement (where the toilets are) that could be used for this purpose. I have changed a diaper there.

name: Tierpark Berlin (Schlossseite)
review: It's on the side of the Schloss at the Tierpark and in good condition. You can enter with a stroller and it's not crowded.

name: Amoreiras Shopping
review: Accessible bathroom, between Zara and the Jean Loius David hairdressing salon. It's on the second floor. There are small individual toilets with a changing table and a toilet available for children too. A spacious area that can be accessed with a stroller. Very convenient for moms and dads.

name: Zenner
review: Update from 2/10 to 4/10 😅 the cover is better, but it's still not cleaned every day (yesterday's dirt is still there today 🙊). Table is still located next to the Dyson hand dryer.

name: Neukölln Arcaden
review: If it's an emergency, you can try using it. But you should also know that there's a better changing table at DM inside the mall...

name: Erchy‘s
review: Close to the urinol, but the table is very good. Is a foldable one so if you’re baby moves a lot, it might be not so ideal.

name: FaNN - Familienhaus Neukölln Nord
review: They have 2 (each one in one bathroom). They are both very practical, they offer diapers.

name: FEZ, Café Zauberbaum
review: Changing table in men‘s AND women’s restroom!! Enough space, but a Dyson hand dryer nearby (a little bit noisy for our little ones)

name: Rossmann
review: Located in the second floor (with elevator) in the kids section of the store.

name: T.Viet
review: It's not a diaper changing table, but a dresser with space for it on top.

name: Daryas Spielcafé
review: The changing table is mounted inside the restroom. It's foldable. There is also a teddy-bear-shaped toilet seat insert for toddlers and a small stool so little ones can reach the sink to wash their hands.

name: Öffentliche Toilette
review: Kostenlos

name: Pomeranze
review: They don't have a real table but a cover that goes on top of the toilet.

name: dm
review: Almost all DM stores have a changing table and some have a nursing area too :)

name: dm
review: very good condition, at the diapers section

name: Smart Kids - Family Play Café
review: People need to take their shoes off. It is a shoes-free-space.

name: dm
review: It's pretty “dm standard”, but the mat could be a little newer (the store opened less than a year ago).

name: Kiezkind Berlin
kids_area_review: There is a sandbox for children to play in, as well as several play areas with toys and books. Outside, when the weather is nice, the venue provides Bobby Cars.

name: La Maison
review: It’s not exactly in the best spot for changing (it’s their cleaning room), but at least there’s one.

name: Forum Gesundheit Neukölln e.V.
review: I have changed my baby many times there during my postpartum course. It is very nice that they have it. The space is a bit tight, but it is doable.

name: Ishin Mittelstraße
review: It's pretty simple, but it also matches the restaurant itself. Bonus point: they are SUPER kids friendly.

name: Westfield Hamburg-Überseequartier
review: There is a kids bathroom and a microwave in the dedicated area.

name: Kap Frida
review: Very nice, clean and new. There is also an extra sink for kids.

name: Standesamt Neukölln
review: Not very beautiful, but you can always use on an emergency.

name: Gal Café
address: Rua do Forno do Tijolo 54A 1170-172 Lisboa
review: The bathroom is small, but they still found a way to install a changing table.

name: Baby & Beans
review:
This is a coffee shop with a playground area full of Montessori and sensory toys, very safe, fun and friendly and with baby food (no salt, no sugar, no gluten).
Owned by two mothers.

name: dm
review: inside the East Side Mall

name: dm
review: It is located on the second floor of the store.

name: IKEA Berlin-Tempelhof
review: Ikea really knows how to treat families. They always deserve praise!

name: dm
review: in "The Playce" basement

name: dm
review: Inside Markthalle Neun

name: Alexa
review: at the food court

name: Manifesto Markt
review: On the first floor, the changing table is in a separate room. It's really nice. There's room for the stroller.

name: Boutique de LA MAISON
review: It’s really bad in a number of ways. First, because it’s just a mat propped up against the window frame (it’s not at a good height for changing the baby). Second, because it’s in a corner and there’s no way to position yourself to change the baby. Not to mention all the products and the “mini storage area” around it. It could be better.

name: WILMA Shoppen
review: There is a dedicated diaper-changing room. Everything is brand-new and well-maintained. There’s plenty of space for the whole family. There’s a microwave and a nursing chair.

name: Kadewe
review: It is located on the 7th floor. Accessible by elevator. Separate from the restrooms, with a tap available and a changing mat.

name: Cafe am Neuen See
review: It's in the hallway, between the bathrooms. It's not very private, but at least there's a changing table. Better than nothing!

name: MaraLou Café
review: It's beautiful! You can tell they put a lot of love into setting up that bathroom. The changing table is simple—it's right on top of the washing machine—but it's so cute.

name: Mignon Sicilian Bakery
review: The bathroom is really nice (I really liked the yellow). The changing table serves its purpose, but it could use a mattress.

name: Zenner
review: Near the hand dryer. The noise startles the baby.

name: Vier Ecken
review: It's really cramped. If you open the changing table, there's no way to get out of the bathroom.
